hyperedges.label: State change write pattern (transition + audit + outbox in one transaction)

nodes.label: Append-only AuditLog
nodes.rationale: A DB trigger rejects UPDATE/DELETE.

nodes.label: orderStateService / listingStateService transition()
nodes.rationale: Only writers of state; optimistic locking, event + audit + outbox rows written in one transaction.

nodes.label: Stored deadline timers + sweeper
nodes.rationale: A lost Redis job never strands an order.

nodes.label: Transactional outbox
nodes.rationale: A crash between commit and enqueue never loses a refund or notification.

nodes.label: A-12 No partner garage: Buy now disabled
nodes.norm_label: a-12 no partner garage: buy now disabled

nodes.label: Outbox side effects (enqueueOutbox / relayOutbox)
nodes.rationale: Job exists only if the business change commits; worker relays every second, sweeper catches rows older than one minute; handlers idempotent since delivery is at least once.

nodes.label: Model S one-platform-fee money model
nodes.rationale: Only model consistent with the brief's vendor rule and the one-fee decision; the owner's worked example charged the fee twice.

nodes.label: A-6 Local pickup may publish without payout; Buy now disabled
nodes.norm_label: a-6 local pickup may publish without payout; buy now disabled

nodes.norm_label: d-3 one platform fee deducted from seller

nodes.norm_label: architecture: web app + worker sharing services

nodes.label: defineAction / defineRoute RBAC wrappers
nodes.rationale: A test walks app/** and fails if any server action or route handler is unwrapped.

nodes.label: Services layer (all business logic)
nodes.rationale: Pages/actions never write via Prisma directly; enforced by an ESLint no-restricted-imports rule.

nodes.norm_label: tech stack (next.js, prisma, supabase, bullmq, tailwind)

nodes.norm_label: photo processing pipeline (exif strip, blur, brightness, phash)

nodes.label: Versioned settings (SettingsSchema)

nodes.label: Deterministic audit selection
nodes.rationale: Hash of order id vs audit % so it is reproducible in tests and audits.

nodes.label: Trust labels (Partner Check / Screened by RePart / Seller-declared)

nodes.label: External service adapters (mock implementations)

nodes.rationale: Signature element answering 'Will this fit my bike?'; the boldest element on listing detail.

nodes.rationale: Store, surface and escalate; never auto-refund or auto-release a dispute.
